kind: Independent output staging accepted with retained permission-boundary evidence
correction: The original byte-success oracle combined successful-write expectations with mode 0444. Actual baseline EACCES and candidate successful directory-authorized replacement are preserved as a distinct permission boundary. Only four successful-write cases per variant were repeated with mode 0644; all other qualified cases were reused unchanged.
permission_boundary: Replacement authorization follows output-directory permissions. Existing mode bits are copied to the new inode; an existing read-only regular file can be replaced when its directory permits replacement.
